newsitem.title: USA: Cirrus Q2 net falls below expectations. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cirrus Q2 net falls below expectations. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]

text.p: Cirrus Logic Inc reported an operating loss for its second quarter ended September 28, 1996 of $0.03 per share, two cents below Wall Street's consensus estimate of a $0.01 per share loss.
By contrast, the company reported $0.47 per share in the fiscal second quarter of 1995.
The latest quarter's operating loss of $0.03 per share was before a one time gain of $0.08 per share on the sale of certain assets.
(Corrects per share and related figures in both paragraphs above)

In a statement, the company did not identify the origin of the gain. However, in July, it announced a deal to sell certain of the assets in its PicoPower product group to National Semiconductor Corp for undisclosed terms.
Including the gain, the company reported net income of $0.05 per share for the 1996 second quarter.
